name: Rhombic plate bending finite element benchmark
description: Provides reference computations and performance evaluation for finite element methods on a rhombic plate bending problem to measure numerical accuracy and solver performance.
evaluation_method: Error norms (L2, L∞), convergence rates and computational performance (solver time/memory)
reputation: A classical reference benchmark in computational mechanics for validating plate-bending finite element methods and solver performance.
notes: Problem-specific numerical benchmark (not an ML/LLM task); scores depend on mesh refinement and numerical method choices; not comparable to percentage-style metrics.
